sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: When throwing a ball at a specific target, where should your eyes be focused?
options: A) On your own hands
B) At the ground in front of you
C) Directly at the target you want to hit
D) At the person standing next to you
questions.answer: C) Directly at the target you want to hit

questions.question_text: To kick a ball powerfully and accurately over a long distance, which part of the foot is generally best to strike with?
options: A) The very tip of the toes
B) The heel
C) The top instep (the laces part of the shoe)
D) The outer edge of the foot
questions.answer: C) The top instep (the laces part of the shoe)

questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of 'follow-through' when you throw or strike an object?
options: A) To look good for the audience
B) To quickly stop your body from moving
C) To maintain maximum power, speed, and directional accuracy
D) To purposely slow down the object's flight
questions.answer: C) To maintain maximum power, speed, and directional accuracy

questions.question_text: In a running relay, what is the best stance while waiting to receive the baton from your teammate?
options: A) Standing completely still with feet together
B) Looking forward and already jogging slowly while reaching your hand back
C) Sitting down to save energy
D) Facing the runner and walking backward
questions.answer: B) Looking forward and already jogging slowly while reaching your hand back

questions.question_text: When attempting to intercept a pass between two opponents, what is the most important skill to use?
options: A) Closing your eyes and jumping
B) Shouting loudly to scare them
C) Anticipating the ball's path and moving quickly to cut it off
D) Standing completely still in the middle
questions.answer: C) Anticipating the ball's path and moving quickly to cut it off

questions.question_text: Which footwork pattern is most effective for a defender trying to closely guard an attacker in basketball or football?
options: A) Crossing your legs while running backward
B) Side-stepping or shuffling while staying low
C) Taking long, slow, heavy steps
D) Hopping on one foot repeatedly
questions.answer: B) Side-stepping or shuffling while staying low

questions.question_text: When striking a shuttlecock with a racket to clear it deep into the opponent's court, what action is crucial?
options: A) Keeping a stiff, unbending wrist
B) Gently pushing the shuttlecock
C) Using a forceful overhead swing with a strong wrist snap
D) Hitting it underhand as softly as possible
questions.answer: C) Using a forceful overhead swing with a strong wrist snap

questions.question_text: What is the correct technique to receive a fast, low pass in soccer safely?
options: A) Kick it back immediately as hard as you can
B) Let it bounce off your shin
C) Cushion it gently using the inside of your foot to drop it nearby
D) Stomp on it with the heel of your foot
questions.answer: C) Cushion it gently using the inside of your foot to drop it nearby

questions.question_text: During agility drills involving 'Little Steps', what is the primary goal?
options: A) To see who can take the longest jump
B) To improve quick foot movement and rapid changes of direction
C) To run at maximum sprinting speed in a straight line for a long time
D) To practice walking on your hands
questions.answer: B) To improve quick foot movement and rapid changes of direction

questions.question_text: When catching a hard-thrown chest pass, why do you bring the ball into your body?
options: A) To hide it from the referee
B) To warm up your hands
C) To absorb the shock and secure the ball safely so you don't drop it
D) To bounce it off your chest immediately
questions.answer: C) To absorb the shock and secure the ball safely so you don't drop it

questions.question_text: Describe the correct position of your non-kicking foot (the plant foot) when attempting a powerful soccer kick. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The plant foot should be placed firmly right next to the ball, pointing straight toward the intended target to ensure balance and directional accuracy.

questions.question_text: Explain why 'follow-through' is important when striking a cricket ball or baseball with a bat. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A full follow-through ensures maximum force is transferred into the strike. It keeps the swing smooth, improves distance, and prevents sudden muscular injuries.

questions.question_text: What is 'interception' in sports, and what specific physical skills do you need to successfully execute it? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Interception is stealing a pass meant for an opponent. It requires sharp visual tracking, quick reflexes, and sudden bursts of sprinting speed to cut off the ball.

questions.question_text: Why is the side-stepping or shuffling footwork pattern important when defending an opponent? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Shuffling allows a defender to move quickly left or right without crossing their legs. This prevents tripping and maintains a strong, balanced, defensive posture.

questions.question_text: Describe how to properly align your body when preparing to catch a ball thrown slightly to your left. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Quickly shuffle your feet to move your entire body to the left, centering your chest squarely behind the ball before extending your hands to catch it.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are teaching a younger student how to correctly perform an overhand throw for maximum distance. Describe the step-by-step mechanical movements you would show them. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Stand sideways to the target. Raise your throwing arm back near your ear, forming an L-shape. Point your non-throwing arm toward the target. Step forward strongly with your opposite foot, rotate your hips forward, and release the ball smoothly with a complete follow-through.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are a goalkeeper facing a penalty kick. Describe the specific stance and visual focus you will use right before the ball is kicked. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would stand with my knees bent deeply, weight on the balls of my feet, and arms slightly raised for quick reaction. My eyes would intensely focus on the ball and the kicker's body angle to instantly anticipate the direction of the shot.

questions.question_text: Explain how a team uses tactical passing and continuous player movement to successfully break down a strong defense and score in a game like basketball or soccer. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: By constantly moving without the ball, attackers force defenders out of their organized positions. Quick, sharp passing tires the defense and prevents them from grouping tightly. This constant motion creates sudden open spaces or gaps, allowing an attacker to sprint through cleanly to receive a pass and take a clear, uncontested shot at the goal.

questions.question_text: Describe the mechanics of performing a successful 'lay-up' in basketball, focusing on the coordination between your eyes, hands, and footwork as you approach the hoop. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: As I approach the right side of the hoop, I focus my eyes on the top corner of the backboard square. I take a strong step with my right foot, then jump high off my left foot. Driving my right knee upward, I extend my right arm completely to gently lay the ball perfectly against the glass.
